items.title: Arista Networks (ANET) Stock Price Rallies After Q3 Earnings Shock

items.title: Arista Networks earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Arista Networks (ANET) reported Q3 FY2026 on Nov 3, 2026, after shares had slid about 25% in three weeks. The stock trades at $178.56 (+5.09%) as of Nov 4, 12:25 PM EST. That is well below the after-hours print of $188.69, which was +11.05% and stamped 3:55 AM EST, so part of the overnight pop has already faded. The 52-week range is $114.52–$217.41.
